speaker: Amiya
content: A death knell.

speaker: Amiya
content: Logos's bone whistle.

speaker: Amiya
content: I'm fine, Doctor.

raw: [name="Amiya"]I'm just reminded of... a lot of things.
speaker: Amiya
content: I'm just reminded of... a lot of things.

raw: [name="Amiya"]Logos rarely conducted himself as Lord of the Banshees when we were at Rhodes Island.
speaker: Amiya
content: Logos rarely conducted himself as Lord of the Banshees when we were at Rhodes Island.

raw: [name="Amiya"]He said he was no different from Scout or Misery, just another Sarkaz operator who believed in the ideals of Rhodes Island.
speaker: Amiya
content: He said he was no different from Scout or Misery, just another Sarkaz operator who believed in the ideals of Rhodes Island.

raw: [name="Amiya"]The day we set out, when Logos put on his Royal Court garment...
speaker: Amiya
content: The day we set out, when Logos put on his Royal Court garment...

raw: [name="Amiya"]I sensed great determination in his eyes...
speaker: Amiya
content: I sensed great determination in his eyes...

speaker: Amiya
content: And great sorrow.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
The bone whistle has cracked. The bone pen has broken. Blood flows the corner of his lips.
content: The bone whistle has cracked. The bone pen has broken. Blood flows the corner of his lips.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: You can no longer use witchcraft.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]You push yourself to the limit, burning all the blood in your body to blow your bone whistle... just to stop me for a moment.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: You push yourself to the limit, burning all the blood in your body to blow your bone whistle... just to stop me for a moment.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Aefanyl...

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: You are a fine warrior.

raw: The Nachzehrer King spreads his arms wide.
content: The Nachzehrer King spreads his arms wide.

raw: The tattered banners draped over him rise up, as though echoing the countless wars the Sarkaz have fought.
content: The tattered banners draped over him rise up, as though echoing the countless wars the Sarkaz have fought.

raw: Rotten flesh and blood fall from his wounds new and old, nourishing the battlefield. New branches sprout from the soil, repairing the warriors that have been damaged by incantations.
content: Rotten flesh and blood fall from his wounds new and old, nourishing the battlefield. New branches sprout from the soil, repairing the warriors that have been damaged by incantations.
The fallen Sudaram rise again.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=3, xstrength=10, ystrength=10, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Nezzsalem"]But you are not fighting one, or a few.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: But you are not fighting one, or a few.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]There have been no shortage of revolutionaries amongst the Sarkaz or the Royal Court. They have all failed, just as Theresa did.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: There have been no shortage of revolutionaries amongst the Sarkaz or the Royal Court. They have all failed, just as Theresa did.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]War is the great boulder destined to fall on top of the Sarkaz in the abyss, again and again.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: War is the great boulder destined to fall on top of the Sarkaz in the abyss, again and again.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: And you...

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]You've gained the Nachzehrers' respect, and so I shall now grant you death.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: You've gained the Nachzehrers' respect, and so I shall now grant you death.

raw: The Nachzehrer walks atop mists of decay towards the young Banshee.
content: The Nachzehrer walks atop mists of decay towards the young Banshee.

speaker: Logos
content: 'Sever.'

raw: The Banshee utters the final incantation, so soft it is almost inaudible. The cutting words become a tangible blade, which he grabs with his hand—
content: The Banshee utters the final incantation, so soft it is almost inaudible. The cutting words become a tangible blade, which he grabs with his hand—

raw: And cuts off the Nachzehrer King's right arm.
content: And cuts off the Nachzehrer King's right arm.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Theresis's swordcraft—

raw: The full blast of the Nachzehrer King's power hits Logos in the chest.
content: The full blast of the Nachzehrer King's power hits Logos in the chest.
He falls from the cliff.

raw: The ground made of Originium begins to collapse.
content: The ground made of Originium begins to collapse.

raw: Logos pictures how the familiar ship treads mountains and rivers, its tracks giving off the same rumbling.
content: Logos pictures how the familiar ship treads mountains and rivers, its tracks giving off the same rumbling.

raw: He remembers the first time he came to Rhodes Island and stood shoulder-to-shoulder on the deck with Theresa. She looked out over Kazdel, while he listened to the wailing in the wind.
content: He remembers the first time he came to Rhodes Island and stood shoulder-to-shoulder on the deck with Theresa. She looked out over Kazdel, while he listened to the wailing in the wind.

raw: He remembers Mechanist hunched over, fiddling with parts, chiding Closure for wasting materials. Outcast and Blaze betting on how long it would last, and a robotic arm reaching over to grab his hat.
content: He remembers Mechanist hunched over, fiddling with parts, chiding Closure for wasting materials. Outcast and Blaze betting on how long it would last, and a robotic arm reaching over to grab his hat.

raw: He remembers Ace's bloodied palm by his shield and cup. Scout's palm was a little cooler, about the temperature of his crossbow, and he could tell them apart by shaking their hands and high-fiving.
content: He remembers Ace's bloodied palm by his shield and cup. Scout's palm was a little cooler, about the temperature of his crossbow, and he could tell them apart by shaking their hands and high-fiving.

raw: He remembers the Doctor and Amiya saying goodnight in the corridors, when Amiya suddenly stopped him to ask if he was ready to go to Londinium.
content: He remembers the Doctor and Amiya saying goodnight in the corridors, when Amiya suddenly stopped him to ask if he was ready to go to Londinium.

raw: He remembers Dr. Kal'tsit taking Amiya's hand and bringing her between them—
content: He remembers Dr. Kal'tsit taking Amiya's hand and bringing her between them—

raw: 'Theresa is gone. Amiya is the new leader of Rhodes Island.'
content: 'Theresa is gone. Amiya is the new leader of Rhodes Island.'
Logos keeps falling—

raw: Falling until he is completely submerged in cold water.
content: Falling until he is completely submerged in cold water.

raw: He remembers himself many years ago.
content: He remembers himself many years ago.

speaker: Laqeramaline
content: You have made your decision.

speaker: Aefanyl
content: Yes.

raw: [name="Aefanyl"]I will stay at Rhodes Island and journey the land with the ship.
speaker: Aefanyl
content: I will stay at Rhodes Island and journey the land with the ship.

speaker: Laqeramaline
content: Theresa is gone.

speaker: Laqeramaline
content: The dream of Babel...

speaker: Aefanyl
content: ...Lives.

raw: [name="Aefanyl"]Her Highness has named her heir. She is young, but carries a familiar fire in her eyes that belongs only to dreamers.
speaker: Aefanyl
content: Her Highness has named her heir. She is young, but carries a familiar fire in her eyes that belongs only to dreamers.

raw: [name="Aefanyl"]And it's not just for her that I choose to stay.
speaker: Aefanyl
content: And it's not just for her that I choose to stay.

raw: [name="Aefanyl"]The journey of Her Highness's search hasn't ended, and it should not end like this. I will continue the journey, as long as the answer to the future of the Sarkaz lies elsewhere.
speaker: Aefanyl
content: The journey of Her Highness's search hasn't ended, and it should not end like this. I will continue the journey, as long as the answer to the future of the Sarkaz lies elsewhere.

raw: [name="Aefanyl"]I may not come back to the Valley for a long time.
speaker: Aefanyl
content: I may not come back to the Valley for a long time.

raw: [name="Laqeramaline"]Do you feel sorry because you cannot stay with us?
speaker: Laqeramaline
content: Do you feel sorry because you cannot stay with us?

raw: [name="Aefanyl"]I will not act as a sovereign of the Royal Court outside the Valley.
speaker: Aefanyl
content: I will not act as a sovereign of the Royal Court outside the Valley.

raw: [name="Aefanyl"]Many will see my will as the will of the Royal Court. They may see the Banshees as their enemies... I'm afraid I won't be able to help you fend off any storms coming from outside the Valley.
speaker: Aefanyl
content: Many will see my will as the will of the Royal Court. They may see the Banshees as their enemies... I'm afraid I won't be able to help you fend off any storms coming from outside the Valley.

raw: [name="Laqeramaline"]If any old friends want to pay a visit, I'll be sure to give them a warm welcome.
speaker: Laqeramaline
content: If any old friends want to pay a visit, I'll be sure to give them a warm welcome.

raw: [name="Aefanyl"]I will not question the former master of the Valley of the Banshees...
speaker: Aefanyl
content: I will not question the former master of the Valley of the Banshees...

raw: [name="Laqeramaline"]My sister and I worry for you in the same way.
speaker: Laqeramaline
content: My sister and I worry for you in the same way.

speaker: Laqeramaline
content: Take our thoughts with you.

raw: The song of the Banshees surrounds their young lord.
content: The song of the Banshees surrounds their young lord.

raw: The water becomes warm, like a pair of warm hands that pull the fallen back.
content: The water becomes warm, like a pair of warm hands that pull the fallen back.
Logos opens his eyes.

raw: He seems to see his mother, and everyone else he holds dear.
content: He seems to see his mother, and everyone else he holds dear.

raw: 'Aefanyl, the most beautiful wave of the Valley, its loveliest song... we must stay and watch you go away...'
content: 'Aefanyl, the most beautiful wave of the Valley, its loveliest song... we must stay and watch you go away...'

raw: 'But our blessing will be with you, wherever you go.'
content: 'But our blessing will be with you, wherever you go.'
Hang in there, Aefanyl.

raw: [name="???"]We're with you. We've always been with you.
content: We're with you. We've always been with you.

raw: The power of incantation fills Logos, to the very ends of his limbs.
content: The power of incantation fills Logos, to the very ends of his limbs.
He opens his lips again.

raw: A song filled with power echoes on the river reflecting the most beautiful wave.
content: A song filled with power echoes on the river reflecting the most beautiful wave.

raw: All the pursuers are compelled to stop.
content: All the pursuers are compelled to stop.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]I never thought I would hear the chorus of the Banshees here in this distant land.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: I never thought I would hear the chorus of the Banshees here in this distant land.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Ever is death accompanied by new life...
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Ever is death accompanied by new life...

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Are you still trying to sway me with song, young one, here at the end of all things?
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Are you still trying to sway me with song, young one, here at the end of all things?

raw: [name="Sudaram"]My Patriarch, this is no more than a Banshee's incantation.
speaker: Sudaram
content: My Patriarch, this is no more than a Banshee's incantation.

raw: [name="Sudaram"]They have not truly joined the battle. Our foe remains only the young Banshee.
speaker: Sudaram
content: They have not truly joined the battle. Our foe remains only the young Banshee.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Yes...

speaker: Sudaram
content: Your injuries are grave...

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]The curse of Aefanyl dictates that decay return to decay. I will not be able to regenerate for some time. But this body will last long enough to see this battle through.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: The curse of Aefanyl dictates that decay return to decay. I will not be able to regenerate for some time. But this body will last long enough to see this battle through.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]For now... let me hear his song, and that of the Banshees.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: For now... let me hear his song, and that of the Banshees.

raw: Nezzsalem walks to the edge of the cliff, without the help of any Arts.
content: Nezzsalem walks to the edge of the cliff, without the help of any Arts.

raw: For an instant, he looks like an ordinary old man.
content: For an instant, he looks like an ordinary old man.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Do you remember Buldrokkas'tee?

speaker: Sudaram
content: Yes.

raw: [name="Sudaram"]You raised him as you would raise your own son.
speaker: Sudaram
content: You raised him as you would raise your own son.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Such a talented boy. He would have become the hero of Kazdel.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Such a talented boy. He would have become the hero of Kazdel.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: He was my best student.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]But he left Kazdel, and died to a conspiracy in a distant land.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: But he left Kazdel, and died to a conspiracy in a distant land.

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]But he died a warrior. He lived the meaning of life through war, and returned to the myriad souls upon his death.
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: But he died a warrior. He lived the meaning of life through war, and returned to the myriad souls upon his death.

speaker: Nezzsalem
content: After that... after that...

raw: [name="Nezzsalem"]Where is the next hero of Kazdel?
speaker: Nezzsalem
content: Where is the next hero of Kazdel?
Nezzsalem looks down the cliff.

raw: Wind passes through the holes in his body that have not healed, creating sounds without meaning.
content: Wind passes through the holes in his body that have not healed, creating sounds without meaning.

raw: [name="Amiya"]The dirge of the myriad souls has grown softer.
speaker: Amiya
content: The dirge of the myriad souls has grown softer.

raw: [name="Amiya"]Logos's bone whistle has temporarily suppressed the link between the Blood of Teekaz and Originium.
speaker: Amiya
content: Logos's bone whistle has temporarily suppressed the link between the Blood of Teekaz and Originium.

speaker: Amiya
content: This is our chance.

raw: [name="Amiya"]Doctor, Dr. Kal'tsit... this time, I won't let it slip from my hands.
speaker: Amiya
content: Doctor, Dr. Kal'tsit... this time, I won't let it slip from my hands.

speaker: Salus
content: ...They've caught up.

speaker: Salus
content: Are you here too, dear Qui'saršinnag?

raw: [name="Salus"]You and our Leader... our dear father. Who will be the one to approach the throne?
speaker: Salus
content: You and our Leader... our dear father. Who will be the one to approach the throne?

raw: Salus reaches for the drop of blood at the top of the altar.
content: Salus reaches for the drop of blood at the top of the altar.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
Originium burns, and the myriad souls roar.
content: Originium burns, and the myriad souls roar.

raw: The powerful witchcraft quickly turns her fingers into charred black crystals.
content: The powerful witchcraft quickly turns her fingers into charred black crystals.

raw: [name="Salus"]I want to see it so badly...
speaker: Salus
content: I want to see it so badly...

speaker: Salus
content: The origin is so near.

speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: You—

speaker: Shining
content: You've hid well.

raw: [name="Shining"]It took a long time to find you. Too long.
speaker: Shining
content: It took a long time to find you. Too long.

speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: Traitor!

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]How many have you killed on your way here?
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: How many have you killed on your way here?

raw: [name="Shining"]...Not more than I killed when I escaped.
speaker: Shining
content: ...Not more than I killed when I escaped.

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]The underground labs were full of the dead back then... our dead.
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: The underground labs were full of the dead back then... our dead.

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]You ruined our Leader's plans at the Royal Academy of Sciences. The Victorians almost found out about it because of you!
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: You ruined our Leader's plans at the Royal Academy of Sciences. The Victorians almost found out about it because of you!

speaker: Shining
content: I wish he had never succeeded.

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]Ha... that's not what you used to say.
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: Ha... that's not what you used to say.

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]How dare you act high and mighty, when you were the one who gave us our orders!
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: How dare you act high and mighty, when you were the one who gave us our orders!

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]That cave outside Londinium, all the research bases... was there any part of it that you weren't in charge of?
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: That cave outside Londinium, all the research bases... was there any part of it that you weren't in charge of?

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]The Leader was in Kazdel most of the time. You were the one who directed the research. You looked exactly like the Leader with your mask on!
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: The Leader was in Kazdel most of the time. You were the one who directed the research. You looked exactly like the Leader with your mask on!

speaker: Shining
content: I had no choice back then.

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]No choice? What about the things you said when you took us to Londinium and had us don this mask?
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: No choice? What about the things you said when you took us to Londinium and had us don this mask?

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]We were mere mercenaries, but we believed in the Confessarii's teachings, believed in the 'First and Final Path' that you preached!
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: We were mere mercenaries, but we believed in the Confessarii's teachings, believed in the 'First and Final Path' that you preached!

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]Our original sin, the sin that outsiders imposed upon us, will be washed away at its coming.
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: Our original sin, the sin that outsiders imposed upon us, will be washed away at its coming.

speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: Was that all a lie?

speaker: Shining
content: I wish that was a lie.

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]it wasn't a lie... it was real. All the Leader's promises to us were sincere. The same for you, Qui'saršinnag, even if you have strayed from the path...
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: it wasn't a lie... it was real. All the Leader's promises to us were sincere. The same for you, Qui'saršinnag, even if you have strayed from the path...

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]The Leader and the Regent are so close to victory.
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: The Leader and the Regent are so close to victory.

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]The freedom and power that have been lost for thousands of years are about to return to the hands of the Sarkaz.
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: The freedom and power that have been lost for thousands of years are about to return to the hands of the Sarkaz.

speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: Kill me if you want.

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]Go and see the Leader. Your father.
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: Go and see the Leader. Your father.

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]He is waiting for you at the end of the path. They're all waiting for you.
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: He is waiting for you at the end of the path. They're all waiting for you.

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]You will witness it for us, for every life that your sword took.
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: You will witness it for us, for every life that your sword took.
Shining removes the guard's mask.

raw: She remembers the face. He was one of the first mercenaries that the Confessarii brought to Londinium.
content: She remembers the face. He was one of the first mercenaries that the Confessarii brought to Londinium.

raw: They knew nothing at first. They were only tasked to excavate the ruins outside the city.
content: They knew nothing at first. They were only tasked to excavate the ruins outside the city.

raw: The young man had expressed his gratitude to her directly, thanked the Confessarii for giving them a safe, well-paid job.
content: The young man had expressed his gratitude to her directly, thanked the Confessarii for giving them a safe, well-paid job.

raw: It was not long before she stopped hearing those words.
content: It was not long before she stopped hearing those words.

raw: The Leader of the Confessarii came to Londinium.
content: The Leader of the Confessarii came to Londinium.

raw: There were no more idle mercenaries drinking and playing games. Everyone put on the same mask, and did not speak except when necessary.
content: There were no more idle mercenaries drinking and playing games. Everyone put on the same mask, and did not speak except when necessary.

raw: They had no special bloodline. Qui'sartuštaj should not have been able to control their will so easily.
content: They had no special bloodline. Qui'sartuštaj should not have been able to control their will so easily.

raw: But the part of them that belonged to themselves died before the great dreams of the Confessarii.
content: But the part of them that belonged to themselves died before the great dreams of the Confessarii.

raw: It was she who killed them first.
content: It was she who killed them first.

speaker: Shining
content: This sin...

speaker: Shining
content: ...has gone on long enough.

raw: The mask cracks. The pieces stab at Shining's palm.
content: The mask cracks. The pieces stab at Shining's palm.

raw: She continues her journey to the top.
content: She continues her journey to the top.
